name: Murloc Head
summary: Along the Western Strand, Murloc Head is grim proof of a threat Southshore wants brought under control. Lieutenant Farren Orinelle collects the severed heads for Marshal Redpath, who requires evidence of the murlocs being culled.

sections.title: A Grislier Kind of Proof
sections.body: Southshore's fishermen and coastal travelers face an immediate threat from aggressive murlocs along the Western Strand. Alliance fighters often clear the beaches, but Marshal Marcus Redpath wants proof before he approves reports of the threat being reduced. Lieutenant Farren Orinelle hires fighters to bring him murloc heads. Farren finds the work repulsive, and the sight has spoiled his appetite for Southshore's seafood.

faq.q: Why does Farren Orinelle want murloc heads?
aliases: who wants murloc heads in southshore
faq.answer: Marshal Marcus Redpath wants physical proof that murlocs have been cleared from the beaches. Lieutenant Farren Orinelle collects their severed heads to satisfy him.

aliases: where to get murloc heads hillsbrad
faq.answer: The murlocs are found along the Western Strand, the coast west of Southshore in Hillsbrad Foothills.

faq.q: Why is Farren so disgusted by them?
faq.answer: Farren finds the murlocs unnatural and stomach-turning. Their severed heads disgust him so much that he refuses to eat fish, a staple of Southshore's diet.

faq.q: Does collecting the heads solve Southshore's murloc problem?
faq.answer: The heads give Marshal Redpath the proof he asked for. He accepts them and sends Farren to deal with threats on the Eastern Strand.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, clearing the Western Strand helps protect Southshore's fishing economy and secure its coastline in Lordaeron.
